terms.title: Terms of service
short: FIG is free for you, and for restaurants. Restaurants can pay to sponsor a spot, always labelled Sponsored.
A deal counts once staff scan your QR at the restaurant.
One account per person. No sharing codes or faking visits.

sections.heading: 1. Who we are
paragraphs: FIG is a local deals app run by FIG Technologies Inc. in Ontario, Canada ("FIG", "we", "us"). These terms cover the FIG app and website. By creating an account, you agree to them and to our Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: 2. Your account
paragraphs: You need an account to use FIG, and you must be 14 or older. If you're under 18, check with a parent or guardian that it's okay. Use your real name, an email and a mobile number, each confirmed with a code. One account per person and per mobile number. Keep your password private. You're responsible for what happens on your account.

sections.heading: 3. How deals work
paragraphs: Deals are offered by restaurants, not by FIG. Each deal shows its own rules (times, limits, dine-in only, and so on) before you claim it.
• A claimed deal is yours until the restaurant ends the deal, or until a flash or dated deal is over.
• At the restaurant, open your QR code. It refreshes every 5 minutes.
• The deal is used once staff scan it. That scan is a "redemption".

Restaurants can change or end a deal at any time. A deal isn't guaranteed until staff scan it. Takeout orders are paid to the restaurant when you pick up. Deals that allow takeout are applied to your order; dine-in only deals are not. If you don't collect an order within 2 hours of its pickup time, it shows as a missed pickup on your takeout record (12 months), which restaurants can see when you order. Nobody reports it and takeout is never switched off for it.

sections.heading: 4. Play fair
paragraphs: Restaurants honour every deal in good faith, so we protect them from abuse. Don't:
• make more than one account
• share, screenshot or sell QR codes
• fake visits or redeem without buying
• use bots, scripts or location spoofing
• harass restaurant staff or other diners
If we see this, we may cancel claims or suspend your account.

sections.heading: 5. Sponsored spots
paragraphs: FIG is free for diners and restaurants. Restaurants can pay FIG to advertise a deal or their restaurant. Paid spots are always labelled Sponsored, and tapping the label says why you see it. Paying never changes a deal, its price or its reviews, and restaurants never get your details from it.

sections.heading: 6. Restaurants and your food
paragraphs: FIG doesn't run any restaurant. Food, prices, service, safety and allergens are the restaurant's responsibility. Dietary filters are a guide only. Always tell staff about allergies before you order.

sections.heading: 7. What you send us
paragraphs: If you send us photos, reports or feedback, you still own them. You let us use them to run and improve FIG. Don't send anything that isn't yours or breaks the law. Reviews must be about your own scanned visit and honest. They're public under your first name and last initial. We can remove reviews that are abusive, fake or off-topic.

sections.heading: 8. Leaving FIG
paragraphs: You can delete your account anytime in Profile → Account & password. We can suspend or close accounts that break these terms. If we do, we'll tell you why unless the law or safety stops us.

sections.heading: 9. Our responsibility
paragraphs: We work hard to keep FIG accurate and running, but it's provided "as is". As far as the law allows, we aren't liable for indirect losses, and our total liability to you is limited to the greater of what you paid us in the last 12 months or $50 CAD. Nothing here removes your rights under Ontario consumer protection law.

sections.heading: 10. Changes to these terms
paragraphs: If we make an important change, we'll tell you in the app at least 14 days before it starts. If you keep using FIG after that, the new terms apply.

sections.heading: 11. Governing law
paragraphs: These terms are governed by the laws of Ontario and the federal laws of Canada that apply there. Disputes go to the courts of Ontario.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
short: We collect what we need to show you deals nearby and check that redemptions are real.
We never sell your personal information.
Restaurants only see what they need to verify your visit.
Location is used while you use FIG, and for alerts only if you turn them on.
You can download or delete your data anytime.

sections.heading: 1. Who's responsible
paragraphs: FIG Technologies Inc. in Ontario, Canada is responsible for your personal information. We follow Canada's privacy law (PIPEDA). Our Privacy Officer answers questions at privacy@fig.app.

sections.heading: 2. What we collect
paragraphs: • Account: name, username, email and mobile number (each confirmed with a code), photo, and your password (stored scrambled, never readable).
• Taste: cravings, budget, dietary needs and home area from Profile setup.

• Location: your precise location while you use FIG, to show nearby deals. It's optional: you can find, claim and use every deal with it off. If you tap I'm here on a takeout order, we keep how far you were from the restaurant with that order. If you turn on arrival reminders, also when you arrive at a restaurant where you have a claimed deal.
• Activity: claims, verified visits, searches, takeout orders, chat messages, and the reviews and photos you post.
• Device: phone model, app version, notification token and crash reports.
• Support: messages and reports you send us.

sections.heading: 3. How we use it
paragraphs: • Show deals and places near you
• Verify redemptions and stop fraud
• Keep a record of your visits, so you can rate them and find places again
• Personalise Home (you can turn this off)
• Send the alerts and emails you chose
• Deliver chat messages between you and a restaurant. Phone numbers typed into a chat are hidden. The FIG team reads a chat only when someone reports it
• Answer support requests and improve FIG
Sponsored spots are the same for everyone in an area: they never use your history. We don't sell your information or show you third-party ads based on it.

sections.heading: 4. Dietary needs
paragraphs: Dietary needs can say something about your health or beliefs, so we treat them as sensitive. They're only used to filter deals for you. They're never shared with restaurants.

sections.heading: 5. What restaurants see
paragraphs: When staff scan your QR, the restaurant sees your first name and last initial, the deal, and the time. Their dashboard shows totals, like "42 redemptions this week", not who you are. Restaurants never see your email, location or history. They never see your mobile number, not even for a takeout order: they reach you by chat or a notification in FIG. Reviews you post are public and show your first name and last initial.

sections.heading: 6. Companies that help us
paragraphs: These companies process data for us, only to run FIG, under contracts that protect it:
• Supabase: database and sign-in
• Vercel: hosting
• Apple and Google: sign-in, maps, notifications

sections.heading: 7. Where your data lives
paragraphs: Some of these companies store data outside Canada, mostly in the United States. There, it's protected by our contracts but also covered by local law.

sections.heading: 8. How long we keep it
paragraphs: We keep your data while your account is open. When you delete your account, we erase your personal information within 30 days. Redemption records are kept without your name for up to 7 years, because restaurants are billed for them and tax law requires it.

sections.heading: 9. Your choices
paragraphs: • See or fix your info in Profile
• Download it in Privacy & terms
• Turn off location, alerts or personalised picks
• Delete your account at any time
Not happy with our answer? You can complain to the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada.

sections.heading: 10. Keeping it safe
paragraphs: We encrypt data in transit, scramble passwords and limit who on our team can access data. No system is perfect. If a breach could put you at risk, we'll tell you and the Privacy Commissioner, as the law requires.

sections.heading: 11. Age
paragraphs: FIG is for people 14 and older. We don't knowingly collect information from anyone younger. If we learn that someone under 14 has an account, we delete it.

sections.heading: 12. Changes
paragraphs: If we change how we use your information in an important way, we'll tell you in the app first, and ask for your consent where the law requires it.

business-terms.title: Business terms
short: FIG is free: joining, your page, deals, scans, takeout and chats. No commission.
Ads are optional: you pay per tap, within the daily budget you set, invoiced monthly.
Honour your live deals exactly as written.
Only your enrolled staff devices can verify scans.

sections.heading: 1. Who these terms are for
paragraphs: These terms apply to restaurants in Canada that use FIG Business. They sit alongside our Terms of service and Privacy policy. By signing up, you confirm you're 18 or older and can accept them for your business.

sections.heading: 2. Your listing
paragraphs: You must run a real, licensed food business at the address you give us, and keep your details accurate. Your page goes live as soon as you finish setting it up. We can pause or remove a listing that breaks these terms.

sections.heading: 3. Your deals
paragraphs: You choose your deals, times and daily limits. While a deal is live, you must honour it exactly as listed. Don't raise prices to cancel out a discount. If you pause a deal, keep honouring claims made before that. Ending a deal is what stops its claims.

sections.heading: 4. What FIG costs
paragraphs: • Joining FIG, setting up your page, going live, posting deals, verified scans, takeout, chats and up to 2 locations are free. There's no commission on the bill, and no sign-up, monthly, listing or per-scan fees.

• FIG Premium is optional: $50 CAD a year plus applicable tax, for your whole account and all its locations. It adds unlimited locations, deal announcements (one every 2 hours, to nearby diners whose cravings match your food and to diners who saved you; diners can turn them off), area insights, and a Premium badge that never changes your ranking. It renews yearly until you cancel. When you buy it through the App Store or Google Play, their payment and refund terms apply.
• You can pay for ads: sponsored spots on Home, in Deals near you, in search and on the map. Ads are optional and never needed to use FIG.

sections.heading: 5. Ads
paragraphs: You make and manage ads in the FIG Ads Manager on our website. Each ad has a daily budget you set, and an optional maximum per tap. You pay only when a diner taps your ad. The price of a tap is set by a short auction among the ads competing for that spot: you pay just enough to beat the next ad, never more than your maximum, and never less than our minimum (currently $0.30 CAD). A diner tapping the same ad more than once in a day is charged once. Your spend never goes past the ad's daily budget or your account's monthly limit.

We send you an invoice for the previous month's taps at the start of each month, payable within 15 days. Prices are in CAD, plus applicable tax. If an invoice goes unpaid, we can put your ads on hold until it's paid.

Ads are always labelled Sponsored. An ad never changes your deal's terms or your reviews. We can decline or stop an ad that breaks these terms (for example, a photo that isn't your food or a deal you don't honour) and we'll tell you why. Results (views, taps, and diners who came in after tapping) are shown in the Ads Manager and in the app. If we charged a tap because of a problem on our side, we credit it on your next invoice.

sections.heading: 6. Wrong scans and disputes
paragraphs: You can report a scan you think is wrong within 14 days. We review it, and if it was a mistake we remove it.

sections.heading: 7. Reviews
paragraphs: Paying for ads never changes, hides or removes reviews. You can reply to reviews in public. Don't offer anything in exchange for a review.

sections.heading: 8. Staff and devices
paragraphs: You're responsible for scans made by your staff and devices. Remove access when someone leaves.

sections.heading: 9. Diner information
paragraphs: You'll see a diner's first name, last initial and the deal they used, never their mobile number or email. Reach a diner only through FIG (chat, or "We're waiting" on a takeout order), and only to serve that deal or order. Don't contact diners outside FIG, and handle their information as Canadian privacy law requires.

sections.heading: 10. Ending the agreement
paragraphs: You can close your business account anytime. Taps up to then are invoiced as usual. We can suspend or close your account if you break these terms, for example by not honouring deals or faking scans. If we close it for any other reason, nothing more is charged.

sections.heading: 11. Responsibility
paragraphs: You're responsible for your food, prices, service and safety, and for any claims about them. FIG is provided "as is". As far as the law allows, our total liability is limited to the greater of the fees you paid us in the last 12 months or $100 CAD.

sections.heading: 12. Changes and law
paragraphs: We'll give you at least 30 days' notice before changing the price. A new price applies from your next renewal. These terms follow Ontario law, and disputes go to the courts of Ontario.
